functions.scope: Cross-object symbol calls only; same-TU/inlined/unwrapped work and bookkeeping remain in parent self time. CPU includes charged ISR; wall includes preemption. No overhead subtraction.

measurement_warning: Function durations and shares are instrumented, not production estimates. Wrapping very frequent symbols perturbs caller self time and flash cache. No guessed overhead correction. Cross-object calls only.

raw_cpu_comparison.scope: Raw decoder only. Task CPU includes charged ISR/instrumentation; Wi-Fi and WebUI remain enabled. No network audio, demux, normalization or PDM. Sequential A/B, not interleaved.
raw_cpu_comparison.percent_definition: CPU budget = task microseconds / decoded audio duration * 100. Above 100 cannot sustain realtime even without output.
